pair.title: Add Deye Hybrid Inverter
pair.nosettings: Please fill in all the required fields.
pair.intro: Enter the IP address, port and Modbus ID of your Deye RTU Modbus converter.
pair.noinverter: Add the Deye Hybrid Inverter first. The battery uses the inverter's connection.
pair.allhavebattery: Every Deye inverter already has a battery device.
pair.noinverter_solar: Add the Deye Hybrid Inverter first. The solar device uses the inverter's connection.
pair.allhavesolar: Every Deye inverter already has a solar device.
pair.noinverter_generator: Add the Deye Hybrid Inverter first. The generator device uses the inverter's connection.
pair.allhavegenerator: Every Deye inverter already has a generator device.
